main.description: Iterate vertex_flight_offer_watch where next_due_at <= now, refresh offers via flight.offer.fetch, and emit drop alerts via flight.offer.checkDrop. Idempotent. Triggered by the R/PT6H timer-start BPMN, but exposed as XRPC for ad-hoc invocation too.

limit.description: Max watchlist rows processed in one invocation (default 50).

force.description: Ignore next_due_at and process every active watch row (default false).
